warnings: op1 direct read (house 11, NEW BOQ FORMAT). This national-standard 'ปร.4' table is NOT rotated and has cleaner columns than houses 08-10's photographed/rotated tables — but text is still small/dense at this scan resolution, so item descriptions and a couple of quantities (1.8, 1.10) are flagged for zoom review rather than force-read.

Rebar grades match S-01's material spec exactly (SR-24 Ø6/Ø9, SD-40 Ø12/Ø16). Two concrete lines (1.4/1.5) both read 'fc\'210 Ksc' — likely distinguishing site-mixed vs ready-mixed concrete pricing, a genuine BOQ convention not seen in houses 08-10's simpler single concrete-price-line format.
